The polling data comes from Civiqs’ rolling online tracking survey of 126,377 responses from registered voters.

A Newsweek analysis compared Civiqs approval figures from August 21, when Trump first announced the tariff waiver, with polling six days later on August 27.

It also looked back at where Trump’s approval rating stood on January 20, 2025, the first day of his second term, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.
